clauses: Section 1. Preamble and Parties. This Master Services Agreement is entered into as of January 1, 2025 by and between Client Inc. and Provider LLC.
Section 2. Scope of Services. Provider agrees to provide software development and consulting services as described in Exhibit A attached hereto.
Section 3. Payment Terms. Invoices shall be payable within thirty (30) days of receipt. Payment due date shall be on or after the Effective Date.
Section 4. Intellectual Property. All work product developed pursuant to Section 2 shall be deemed work made for hire owned by Client.
Section 5. Confidentiality. Each party agrees to maintain in strict confidence all proprietary information disclosed under this Agreement.
Section 6. Term and Termination. The effective date of this Agreement is January 1, 2025 and the termination date shall be December 31, 2025.
Section 7. Indemnification. Provider shall defend and indemnify Client against any third-party claims arising from a breach of Section 5.
Section 8. Limitation of Liability. Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential damages arising under this Agreement.
Section 9. Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
Section 10. Miscellaneous. This Agreement, including Exhibit A, constitutes the entire understanding between the parties.
Exhibit A. Statement of Work. Scope details, technical deliverables, and milestone specifications.

Section 1. Preamble and Parties. This Master Services Agreement is entered into as of January 1, 2025 by and between Client Inc. and Provider LLC.

Section 2. Scope of Services. Provider agrees to provide software development and consulting services as described in Exhibit A attached hereto.

Section 4. Intellectual Property. All work product developed pursuant to Section 2 shall be deemed work made for hire owned by Client.

Section 3. Payment Terms. Invoices shall be payable within thirty (30) days of receipt. Payment due date shall be on or after the Effective Date.

Section 5. Confidentiality. Each party agrees to maintain in strict confidence all proprietary information disclosed under this Agreement.

Section 6. Term and Termination. The effective date of this Agreement is January 1, 2025 and the termination date shall be December 31, 2025.

Section 7. Indemnification. Provider shall defend and indemnify Client against any third-party claims arising from a breach of Section 5.

Section 8. Limitation of Liability. Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential damages arising under this Agreement.

Section 9. Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.

Section 10. Miscellaneous. This Agreement, including Exhibit A, constitutes the entire understanding between the parties.

Exhibit A. Statement of Work. Scope details, technical deliverables, and milestone specifications.
